meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Agar aapki skin **acne-prone/oily** hai, to **₹700 ke andar sabse practical choice 2% Salicylic Acid serum** hota hai, kyunki ye pores ko unclog karke active pimples aur blackheads par kaam karta hai.[4][7][10][11]  
Agar acne ke saath **marks/post-acne spots** bhi hain, to **10% Niacinamide + Zinc** ya **Azelaic Acid** serum better option ho sakta hai.[1][5][8][9]

**Best picks under ₹700:**
- **Dot & Key Cica + 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — ₹467; acne-prone, oily, sensitive skin ke liye listed hai.[7]
- **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid Face Serum** — sale price ₹599.25; acne, blackheads, open pores ke liye positioned hai.[8]
- **Myupchar 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum** — ₹539; acne, pimples, open pores ke liye listed hai.[6]
- **The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide Face Serum** — ₹222; acne marks/oil control ke liye budget-friendly option hai.[1]
- **Pilgrim 10% Niacinamide Face Serum** — ₹649; acne marks aur blemishes ke liye listed hai.[5]

**Mera simple recommendation:**
- **Active pimples + oily skin:** **Dot & Key 2% Salicylic Acid**
- **Marks + excess oil:** **The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide**
- **Sensitive acne-prone skin:** **Azelaic Acid serum** ya **low-strength niacinamide** better rahega.[1][5][10]

**Use ka short rule:**  
- Salicylic Acid serum ko *raat* me 2–3 din/hafta se start karo.  
- Niacinamide ko daily use kiya ja sakta hai agar skin tolerate kare.  
- Naya serum use karne par patch test karna useful hota hai.
